lines.text: Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
Jabez called out to the God of Egypt to bless him and enlarge his territory, and God granted it.
Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters, but his brothers did not have many children.
In Hezekiah's days, the Simeonites journeyed to the entrance of Gedor in search of pasture and attacked the Hamites and Meunites there.
Five hundred Simeonites went to Mount Carmel and struck down the remnant of the Amalekites who had escaped.
